remaining_doubts: Transition brackets 4509, 4503, 4504, 4511 (and -Black) are badged "10 to 15" on the page; series recorded as ["15"] only because the schema excludes "10". The 10-to-15 nature is kept in notes and description.

Hardware rows 3386, 3393, 3319, 3435 and 3320 on pages 4-104 to 4-107 are badged "10 to 15", so both bolt sizes are attached to each transition bracket. The 1/4-20 bolt (3386/3393) presumably goes on the 10 series side, but the page does not say that outright.
